fed.detail: 2Y Treasury 4.63% (-25 bp over 5 sessions, as of 2026-11-20). Markets expect a softer Fed, which supports gold.

oil.label: Oil falling
oil.detail: WTI 83.41 (-6.2% 1w): less energy inflation, less reason for the Fed to hike.

stocks.detail: S&P futures 6,935 (-8.5% 1w). In a panic, gold can get sold too while funds raise cash. Expect bigger swings.
